additional_limitations:
Use of this data is subject to the CHHS Terms of Use and any copyright and proprietary notices incorporated in or accompanying the individual files.

The information in the dataset was retrieved from the PMF, which is compiled based on the enrollment applications submitted by providers.  Therefore, the dataset contains a small amount of records with incomplete or inaccurate information, such as an inappropriate provider type or a missing specialty code.
data_collection_tool: Data is retrieved from the PMF in the Management Information System/Decision Support System (MIS/DSS) data warehouse​.  The PMF is compiled based on the enrollment applications submitted by providers.
description:
The dataset provides basic information of the FFS providers enrolled in the Medi-Cal program as of October 26, 2026.  The data was retrieved from the Provider Master File (PMF), which has been used in the claims payment process and maintained by the Provider Enrollment Division (PED).  The Variables in the dataset include provider number, name, type, specialty, geographic information, etc.  This dataset does not include the Managed Care providers.

__Note: Data may be subject to a 1-2 day lag for quality assurance.__
name: profile-of-enrolled-medi-cal-fee-for-service-ffs-providers
related_resources: ​Information of the National Plan & Provider Enumeration System (NPPES):  https://nppes.cms.hhs.gov/NPPES/Welcome.do

resources.description:
The dataset provides enrollment and geographic data for Fee-for-Service (FFS) providers enrolled in the Medi-Cal. The data is based on a point in time, and it is to be updated monthly. The enrollment provider data is as of October 26, 2026. This dataset does not include Dental Fee-for-Service providers. 

__Note: Data may be subject to a 1 to 2 day lag for quality assurance.__

fields.description:
Exam Room (E) - The entrance to the exam room is accessible with a clear path. The doors open wide enough to accommodate a wheelchair or scooter and are easy to open. The exam room has enough room for a wheelchair or scooter to turn around. 

* Y= Provider office has exam room accommodation
* N= Provider office does not have exam room accommodation
fields.name: Acc_Exam_Room
fields.title: Accommodation: Exam Room

fields.description:
Exterior Building (EB) - Curb ramps and other ramps to the building are wide enough for a wheelchair or scooter. Handrails are provided on both sides of the ramp. There is an accessible entrance to the building. Doors open wide enough to let a wheelchair or scooter enter and have handles that are easy to use. 

* Y= Provider office has exterior building accommodation
* N= Provider office does not have exterior building accommodation
fields.name: Acc_Exterior_Building
fields.title: Accommodation: Exterior Building

fields.description:
Interior Building (IB) - Doors open wide enough to let a wheelchair or scooter enter and have handles that are easy to use. Interior ramps are wide enough and have handrails. Stairs, if available, have handrails. If there is an elevator, it is available for public use at all times when the building is open. The elevator has enough room for a wheelchair or scooter to turn around. If there is a platform lift, it can be used without help. 

* Y= Provider office has interior building accommodation
* N= Provider office does not have interior building accommodation
fields.name: Acc_Interior_Building
fields.title: Accommodation: Interior Building

fields.description:
Parking (P) - Parking spaces, including spaces designated for vans, are accessible. Pathways have curb ramps between the parking lots, offices, and at drop-off locations. 

* Y= Provider office has parking accommodation
* N= Provider office does not have parking accommodation
fields.name: Acc_Parking
fields.title: Accommodation: Parking

fields.description:
Restroom (R) - The restroom is accessible, and the doors are wide enough to accommodate a wheelchair or scooter and are easy to open. The restroom has enough room for a wheelchair or scooter to turn around and close the door. There are grab bars that allow easy transfer from wheelchair to toilet. The sink is easy to get to and the faucets, soap, and toilet paper are easy to reach and use. 

* Y= Provider office has restroom accommodation
* N= Provider office does not have restroom accommodation
fields.name: Acc_Restroom
fields.title: Accommodation: Restroom

fields.description:
Medical Equipment (T) - The exam table moves up and down and the scale is accessible with handrails to assist people with wheelchairs and scooters. The weight scale can accommodate a wheelchair. Patients can get on or off medical equipment with or without help. 

* Y= Provider office has medical equipment accommodation
* N= Provider office does not have medical equipment accommodation
fields.name: Acc_Medical_Equipment
fields.title: Accommodation: Medical Equipment

fields.description:
Patient Areas (PA) - Patients can get to and use all common areas and equipment with or without help. 

* Y= Provider office has patient areas accommodation
* N= Provider office does not have patient areas accommodation
fields.name: Acc_Patient_Areas
fields.title: Accommodation: Patient Areas

fields.description:
Patient Diagnostic and Treatment Use (PD) - Patients are able to access and use testing and treatment areas, and equipment. 

* Y= Provider office has patient diagnostic and treatment use accommodation
* N= Provider office does not have patient diagnostic and treatment use accommodation
fields.name: Acc_Patient_Diagnostic
fields.title: Accommodation: Patient Diagnostic and Treatment Use

fields.description: Indicates if the provider is a **FFS billing provider** or a **FFS non-billing provider**. A FFS billing provider is defined as an actively enrolled Fee-For-Service (FFS) provider who bills for services they provide using their own provider (NPI) number. A FFS non-billing provider is defined as an actively enrolled individual Fee-For-Service (FFS) provider who directly renders healthcare services to Medi-Cal members and does not submit claims directly to Medi-Cal for services provided.
